headline: Judge dismisses antitrust lawsuits over Google's AI Overviews
summary: A federal judge dismissed antitrust lawsuits brought by Chegg and Penske Media against Google over its AI Overviews search feature. The court found Google may hold a search monopoly but that the lawsuits failed to show it was being unlawfully leveraged, acknowledging AI search has consequences without that making it an antitrust violation.
